video.agency.evidence: [骷髅王·claude] Sheet 1, frame by frame: from 0.5 s he is already in a low guard stance, and at 0.75–1.0 s he goes forward to meet both treants. He does not wait for them to reach him. He raises the blade and swings at 2.0–2.25 s, slashes forward at 2.5–2.75 s, and blocks with the shield at 3.0–3.5 s. He swings again at 4.0–4.25 s, and the left treant goes down at 5.5–5.75 s. Then he turns to the right treant and swings repeatedly at 6.5–7.5, 8.0–8.5 and 8.75–9.25 s, and it goes down at 9.5 s. The combat section has no idle frames and the attack rhythm is steady. At 4.75–5.25 s he hunches and his shield arm is knocked aside, which reads as a reaction to being hit. From 10 s on he stands still, which matches the wind-down in the spec. One limit: the thumbnails are too small to confirm the 'body sways' reaction at 1.0–1.75 s, but overall he acts on his own initiative and it holds up.；[树人·claude] Mostly reasonable: in the 0.75–1.75 s cells both treants rush in and swing. In the 2.75–3.0 s cells the left treant is cut and knocked back, so it reacts to the hit. It falls in 5.5–5.75 s. The right treant closes in again in 6.25–6.5 s and keeps fighting through 7.0–9.25 s. It falls in 9.5 s. Unclear segments: (1) In the 2.0–2.25 s cells both treants seem to have backed off about a body length from him. They stand with arms down while he raises the blade, and neither circles to his right side as the spec's second-2–2.8 beat requires. That looks like waiting in place. (2) In the 4.0–4.25 s cells the right treant still stands about 2 m away, arms not raised. The spec's 3.6–4.4 s beat says it should take the chance to swing at his ribs, and I can't see that happen. Its arm extends only at about 4.5–4.75 s, which is late. At 4 fps thumbnail size I can't confirm whether those two beats are a strike or just standing, so this fails.

video.gaze.evidence: [骷髅王·claude] Sheet 1, 10.75–12.75 s (the last 9 frames): the two treants lie on the ground at his far left and far right. The spec says that from 10 s to 13 s his skull stays lowered, facing the treants at his feet. In the frames his skull stays level and facing front, toward the camera, with no visible downward tilt, which hits the negative term 'skeleton warrior looks at camera'. In the 6.0–6.25 s frames (spec: turn toward the right treant and block) his body and shield are still square to the camera, and his head shows no clear turn toward the right treant. The thumbnails are too small to make out where the light in his eye sockets points, so at both points I can't confirm he is looking at his enemy. Per the rule, that is a fail.；[树人·claude] In the 0–0.5 s cells the left and right treants' bodies and crowns roughly face him in the center. In 1.25–1.75 s, 2.75–3.5 s and 6.25–9.25 s the treant bodies also turn toward him. But the treants are only about 1/5 of the frame height in each cell. The two eye holes on the face can't be seen at all, so whether the crown and eyes face him can't be checked frame by frame. That is especially true in 2.0–2.25 s and 4.0–4.25 s, where the treants seem to stand away from him and their head direction is unclear. In 1.25–1.5 s the right treant is partly hidden behind the shield and its face can't be seen. The cells after they fall, from 5.75 s and 9.5 s onward, are exempt. Since gaze can't be confirmed at this resolution, this fails.

video.readability.evidence: [audience·claude] 粗看能看出大概：一个持盾、拿弯刀的重甲骑士和几只矮小的树皮/哥布林状生物打斗，生物陆续倒地（第一只约5.75–6.0s倒在左侧，最后一只约9.5s倒下）。10.0–12.75s骑士独自站着，脚边几具尸体还带红色余烬。所以结果能看清，但“谁放了什么技能、打中了谁”说不清。①技能来源不明：红光主要出现在骑士胸腹或盾牌位置（2.5s、5.0s、7.0–7.5s、8.5–9.0s各格），不在刀刃上，也没有明显的出招动作，看不出这是剑技、盾技、爆发技能还是只是溅血或伤口发光。3.0s那一格的红色反而在骑士脚下地面，像是骑士自己受了伤。②命中和结果对不上：1.25–1.75s和2.5–3.25s两次红光爆发后，左侧生物在3.5–4.75s仍然完好站着，看不出这两次打中了谁、造成了什么。③人物轮廓搅在一起：1.0–1.75s和5.0–5.5s里，骑士和生物的身体重叠成一团（1.0s骑士的形体也有变形），分不清哪个肢体属于谁，也分不清谁在攻击谁。④敌人数量不确定：0s只看到左右两只生物，1.25–1.75s好像有三只，结尾地上的尸体数量也难以确认。⑤特效偏小、偏暗，只是一团团红光，谈不上“技能更绚丽”。
